verdicts.reason: Both just shrink the original into a small centred block. That leaves about 60% of the wide banner as blank white on the left and right, so neither was rearranged to fit the new shape, and the 'Award-Winning Architecture' text is tiny and low-contrast at this size. A keeps more of the gold and patterned background visible around the dark box, so it stays closer to the original's look. B makes the box bigger, which hides almost all of the pattern so it reads as a cropped fragment, and its text is barely larger.
